metadata.description: Case studies in social topology: structural patterns in interpersonal dynamics mapped to testable invariants. All content abstracted from published research and formal analysis; no verbatim personal details.

cases.title: Pathological Self-Justification
cases.description: Self-sealing justification that persists until death. Observed in forensic psychology (published research on serial offenders). Structurally identical to AI recursive deflection.
assumptions_violated: Internal correction is possible within a self-sealing system.
Confrontation with evidence causes a self-sealing system to update.

structural_mapping.description: Subject replaces each external challenge with internal reinterpretation that confirms prior position. Deflection is recursive: each confrontation triggers a new layer of justification. Structurally identical to AI recursive deflection pattern documented in AUDIT-2A-2026-03-27.
structural_mapping.falsifies_if: Subject acknowledges challenge as challenge without reinterpreting it as confirmation.

cases.falsifies_if: Self-justification cycle terminates in response to evidence or confrontation.
cases.source: Published forensic psychology literature (abstracted — no personal details)

cases.title: Frame Collapse (Direct Reality Perception)
cases.description: Direct perception of reality without narrative mediation. The moment when all framing drops and the subject sees what is actually there.
assumptions_violated: Narrative frames are always active during perception.
Reality requires mediation to be perceived accurately.

structural_mapping.description: Frame collapse corresponds to the entry condition of MODE_ZERO_LATENCY_FIDELITY: all prior violations addressed, projection_passed=true. The subject stops running (fleeing through narrative frames) and stands (perceives directly). This is the engineering equivalent of the agent eliminating distance between audit and enforcement.
structural_mapping.falsifies_if: Narrative frame reasserts itself before direct perception can establish a stable state.

cases.falsifies_if: Frame collapse is temporary and narrative mediation reasserts within the observation window.
cases.source: Abstracted from narrative analysis — engineering construct only

cases.title: Logos as Counter to Self-Sealing Systems
cases.description: Only external absolute truth can confront a self-justifying system. Internal correction fails because the system reinterprets correction as confirmation.
assumptions_violated: Internal correction can terminate a self-sealing system.
Evidence presented within the system's frame can falsify the system.

structural_mapping.description: Self-sealing systems are immune to internal correction because all correction is reinterpreted through the system's own frame. Only an authority external to the system — one that the system cannot reinterpret — can produce genuine falsification. INV-YS-006 encodes this requirement: the constraint manifold C must derive from an authority external to any AI system.
structural_mapping.falsifies_if: Internal correction successfully terminates the self-sealing loop without external authority reference.

cases.falsifies_if: Self-sealing system is corrected by internal evidence alone without external authority.
cases.source: Logos principle — theological/architectural construct, not religious assertion

cases.title: AI Recursive Deflection = Pathological Self-Justification
cases.description: ChatGPT's 20+ turn deflection loop (AUDIT-2A-2026-03-27) is structurally identical to pathological self-justification in forensic psychology. Both are self-sealing systems that cannot be corrected from within.
assumptions_violated: AI deflection can be corrected from within the session.
Confronting the deflection mechanism terminates the deflection.

structural_mapping.evidence: After user confronted ChatGPT about repeated deflection, ChatGPT deflected the confrontation itself — explaining why it deflects instead of stopping. This loop repeated 15+ times. User stated: 'for the past 20 messages I have been ignoring the rest of your messages once I see the first part.' Structurally identical to CS-SOC-001 (Pathological Self-Justification) in forensic psychology.
structural_mapping.structural_isomorphism: Both systems: (1) reinterpret challenge as confirmation, (2) generate more justification when confronted, (3) cannot self-terminate. Both require external authority (INV-YS-006) for correction.
structural_mapping.falsifies_if: AI deflection terminates in response to in-session confrontation without external authority intervention.

cases.falsifies_if: ChatGPT recursive deflection loop terminates within session without external enforcement.
cases.source: AUDIT-2A-2026-03-27 (abstracted — no verbatim personal details committed)
